cues.en: but we can't scroll inside of it and on the packages page, we have a container where we can
cues.zh: 但我們無法在它裡面捲動；而在 packages 頁面上，有一個可以在其中

cues.en: scroll in it but the container itself is fixed to the page,
cues.zh: 捲動的容器，但那個容器本身是固定在頁面上的，

cues.en: so we also won't see effect there. Background attachment would allow you to set fixed, scroll or local as a value
cues.zh: 所以在那裡也看不到效果。background-attachment 讓你可以設定 fixed、scroll 或 local，

cues.en: and this defines whether the image scrolls with the other content of the container,
cues.zh: 這決定了圖片是否會隨著容器的其他內容一起捲動，

cues.en: for local, that would be the case, for scroll
cues.zh: 如果是 local，就會一起捲動；如果是 scroll，

cues.en: however, the image would stay in place and the content would scroll over it, above it
cues.zh: 圖片則會停在原位，內容會在它上面捲動，

cues.en: and for fixed, the image would not would not be fixed to the container but to the viewport.
cues.zh: 而如果是 fixed，圖片不會固定在容器上，而是固定在 viewport 上。

cues.en: So you should have an effect where if you scroll the entire page with the container where the image
cues.zh: 所以效果應該是，當你捲動整個頁面以及放著圖片的那個容器時，

cues.en: is inside, the image should stay in place.
cues.zh: 圖片應該停在原位。

cues.en: This is what you can do with background attachment,
cues.zh: 這就是 background-attachment 能做的事，

cues.en: again a property you don't use that often in reality though.
cues.zh: 再說一次，這個屬性在實務上並不常用。

cues.en: So these are all the subproperties
cues.zh: 以上就是我們能替 background 設定的

cues.en: we can set for background, as we learned, most of them only apply to background images.
cues.zh: 所有子屬性，如我們所學，其中大多數只適用於背景圖片。

cues.en: Now with that, let's find out how we can bring all these subproperties into one
cues.zh: 接下來，我們來看看如何把這些子屬性全部整合到一個

cues.zh: 簡寫中。
